text:
Maria (infra): heads up — started seeing NATGW conntrack spikes after yesterday's audit-log endpoint change. GPU warm-pool nodes failing to finish bootstrap (keystore decrypt timeout). I think audit shipper is sending to new external endpoint.
Alex (sre): Oof. Symptoms?
Maria (infra): lots of 502s from keystore proxy, /var/log/keystore shows tls handshake timeouts. natgw conntrack at ~90% on ap-south. Affected: warm-pool + canary nodes in ap-south; prod region at risk if we scale.
Alex (sre): Are we sure it's audit endpoint and not S3 burst?
Maria (infra): Correlation: deploy changed audit target to mirror.forwarding.redwood-audit.net (egress). Keystore decrypt requests are small but bursty during warmup and audit shipper does a full-secondary push on node join.
Ben (platform): Cost & capacity note: If we route audit to privatelink S3 instead we'll avoid natgw but add an extra per-region privatelink charge. Rough calc: ~0.6c per 1000 requests vs $0.02/GB natgw egress. Need quick decision.
Lina (security): We can't keep audit unencrypted; privatelink + KMS is preferred for compliance. But we can sample audit traffic during ramp.
Alex (sre): Short-term mitigation: flip audit shipper to sampled mode for warmpool joins only, and disable full push during node join. Can we push a dry-run config?
Maria (infra): I'll push a dry-run to staging then to ap-south canary. Command I used locally:
```
kubectl -n infra set env deploy/audit-shipper AUDIT_MODE=sampled WARMPOOL_SAMPLE=0.05
```
Alex (sre): Nice. Also propose adding backpressure on keystore proxy: limit concurrent decrypt to 50 and queue 200. Config snippet:
```
keystore.max_concurrent_decrypt=50
keystore.request_queue=200
```
SRE-Oncall: If we go sampling, need alerting change — reduce alert noise but keep a pager if decrypt error rate > 1% for 5m.
Ben (platform): For cost decision, I'll run quick numbers. If sampling at 5%, natgw peak drops below conntrack threshold and GPU warmups succeed. Privatelink rollout can be tracked as next sprint.
Lina (security): Approve sampling for warmpool-only as short-term, but put privatelink + private-s3 as required medium-term. Audit retention policy unchanged.
Maria (infra): Plan: 1) roll sampling dry-run to ap-south canary (10m window) 2) apply keystore backpressure 3) monitor conntrack and GPU join success 4) if green, roll to other regions and schedule privatelink rollout. I'll start the canary in 2m and post updates.
Alex (sre): I'll prepare a rollback playbook if warmpools still fail (scale down warmpool, drain joiners).
SRE-Oncall: I've muted noncritical decrypt alerts for the next 30m while we test.
Maria (infra): Dry-run started (canary). Posting logs to thread in 10m. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: deployment/audit-shipper updated in staging by maria — rollout 1/3
Maria (infra): Log tail snippet from canary:
```
2026-03-21T11:05:12Z INFO audit-shipper sample_rate=0.05 joined_node=ip-10-0-1-23
2026-03-21T11:05:13Z WARN keystore decrypt_timeout=120ms node=ip-10-0-1-23
```
Alex (sre): Looks like decrypt timeouts reduced, conntrack trending down. Good to expand after 15m.
Ben (platform): I'll prepare cost calc and a short proposal for privatelink sizing. ETA 2h.
Lina (security): I'll file a compliance note recording the temporary sampling and the long-term privatelink requirement.
Maria (infra): Thanks — will update thread with final verdict after 15m.
